title: Ozarks Lyric Opera Presents: Tosca 3/19
seo_title: Ozarks Lyric Opera: Tosca at Gillioz Theatre, Mar 19
description: Ozarks Lyric Opera presents Puccini's Tosca for the first time, an opera about love, betrayal, political intrigue, and murder, conducted and directed by Kyle Wiley Pickett and Alice Wiley Pickett. Seating is reserved, and the listing notes that not all productions may be appropriate for every person or for all ages. It takes place Friday, March 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM (doors 6:30 PM) at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri.
